evidence.quote: We have seen inflation cool significantly, falling more rapidly than at any time since the 1980s.
Yet unemployment remains near the lowest levels seen only a few times since the 1960s.
I am cautiously optimistic that we will see continued progress on disinflation without significant deterioration of the labor market.
Fortunately, these supply shortages for both goods and labor have mostly dissipated.
Fortunately, we appear to have avoided a wage–price spiral this time, as I will discuss later.

parsed.rationale: The largely academic speech emphasizes rapid disinflation driven by supply recovery, anchored expectations and a strong labor market, and expresses optimism about continued progress, a mildly dovish lean. It gives no explicit guidance on the rate path or balance sheet.
